notes: STS-134's own rendezvous I-loads in G2 (GNC OPS 2): every word of the orbit-targeting (#PCGZ*, #DGW*) and relative-navigation (#PCGN*, #DGL*) csects that the flight's load changed from the load module. Source: the PATCH SUMMARY of PFS/mafgen/DASS_G2.ASC, the MAFGEN listing of STS-134's own GNC2 load ('STS134/OI034/C2 MDD 134.09 DASS GNC2', 13 Dec 2010): 'was' is its LM column (the load module, what this tape holds), H its MM column (the flight's); corrected-G2.fcm, the flown G2 dump, holds the MM value in every one of these cells. PASS-IDLE independently sent the flown values of CGZB_LAMB_ILOAD and the GLQREN locals from the DASS G2 dump (pure-G2.fcm), 2026-10-09; they agree here except that PASS-IDLE listed the Lambert flags 28 and up OFF, where DASS_G2.ASC and corrected-G2.fcm both have 29-40 ON (28 OFF) -- sets 29-40 are not used by STS-134's rendezvous. Among the cells: GLQREN's sensor bias INITs 1.0 -> 0.0, TAU_RR 600 -> 4000, VAR/BIAS_VAR_RRDOT; CGZB_LAMB_ILOAD sets 9-14, 19, 25-27, 29-40 ON; GL5_VEL_THRESH 0.9 -> 0.06 ft/s; GWQ/GWS/GWX's CGZV_DEL_X_GUESS, DEL_X_TOL (1E7 -> 1E-2, 1E-8), ICMAX, EL tolerances, DEL_T_MAX; the target sets 9-39 (T1/DT/EL/ROFF_ILOAD). RENDEZVOUS_PLAN.md 5e. Cells are found by their context in a G2 memory image (--mem: an OPS 2 capture taken before RNDZ NAV ENA, e.g. a fly_rndz134 run's sts134r-ipl). CGNS_GPS_LOCKOUT (#PCGNGPS) is left to sts134-gps-lockout.json. Positions: "flat" (volume data halfwords) found per csect -- each csect's offset on the volume located by a distinctive run of its own halfwords and confirmed cell by cell (the "was" value there and at least 48 of the 80 surrounding halfwords agreeing with an OPS 2 capture, rr-run2/sts134r-ipl); #DGLJRCV's four copies (one per configuration) all changed. Not placed, so not on the volume: #PCGNFLT CGNS_EXP_SHAPE_FACTOR, #PCGNFLT CGNS_CDA, #PCGNFLT CGNS_CDF, #PCGNFLT CGNS_CDN, #PCGNFLT CGNS_CDS, #PCGNFLT CGNS_T_GPS_CYCLE, #PCGNFL2 CGNS_KFACTOR, #PCGNFL2 CGNS_MEAS_THRESHOLD+1, #PCGNREM CGNS_GPS_UPPER_ANT_BORESIGHT2, #PCGNREM CGNS_GPS_UPPER_ANT_BORESIGHT3, #PCGNREM CGNS_GPS_LOWER_ANT_BORESIGHT1, #PCGNREM CGNS_GPS_LOWER_ANT_BORESIGHT2, #PCGNREM CGNS_GPS_LOWER_ANT_BORESIGHT3. CGZB_LAMB_ILOAD's set 7 (X'0E354') is not in the PATCH SUMMARY (the DASS load module already had it OFF) but this tape has it ON; its cell was added by hand from the flown dump (OFF in DASS_G2.ASC's memory map and in corrected-G2.fcm).
